data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding was $609.34m. Analysis of development shows a very small net favourable prior-year movement (approximately $0.2m release) across older underwriting years. The report notes a $10.7m profit on development of the 2017 and prior years driven by reinsurance to close arrangements and favourable development, while the 2018 pure year incurred losses driven by 2018 catastrophe events. Current year catastrophe activity (Hurricane Laura, Sally, Midwest Derecho and US wildfires) and COVID-19 produced material current-year claims, but prior-year reserve movements were modest. The prior-year movement was derived from the claims development triangle and may be influenced by a split RITC transaction undertaken during closure of the 2018 year.
raw_causal_phrases: a profit of $10.7m on the development of the 2017 and prior years of account during the 2020 calendar year.
The total net cost to Syndicate 1969 of these events for the 2020 calendar year was $23.4m
The estimated net cost to Syndicate 1969 for the 2020 calendar year was $13.6m
The RITC of the 2017 and prior years liabilities removes the risk of adverse reserving development for Syndicate 1969.

we have therefore made a substantial provision for claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR") in the calendar year to allow for this reserving uncertainty.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (current estimate vs prior diagonal) and totals approximately a $0.2m release. A split RITC (transfer of 2017 & prior liabilities to Syndicate 1994) occurred in closing the 2018 year which can distort the triangle; the report also explicitly states a $10.7m profit on development of 2017 & prior years (referenced in text) which relates to the RITC. Where gross prior-year movement figures were not explicitly presented in a dedicated prior-year movement note, the triangle was used (source 4). All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD). The field names include '_gbp_m' but amounts are in USD millions per the report.
